# ClearPro Tech LLC

> ClearPro Tech LLC is a United States-based artificial intelligence and healthcare technology company building AI healthcare software, digital dentistry solutions, workflow automation, and custom software platforms for organizations worldwide.

## Primary website
- Homepage: https://www.clearprotech.com/
- Canonical URL: https://www.clearprotech.com/
- Registered address: 5830 E 2nd St, Ste 7000 #37797, Casper, WY 82609, United States

## What ClearPro Tech does
- AI solutions: AI-powered systems for automation, communication, analysis, decision support, predictive analytics, natural language processing, and workflow optimization.
- Healthcare technology: Digital healthcare platforms and cloud software supporting collaboration, data intelligence, and patient-centered workflows.
- Digital dentistry: ClearPro Lab is a cloud-based digital dental laboratory management platform connecting clinics, dental laboratories, dentists, technicians, and healthcare teams.
- Custom software development: Scalable web applications, progressive web apps, API integrations, and business automation built around unique requirements.

## ClearPro Lab
- Product website: https://clearprolab.com
- ClearPro Lab supports case management, real-time clinic-lab communication, AI-assisted messaging, workflow automation, digital treatment tracking, secure cloud infrastructure, and laboratory productivity workflows.
- **Key 2026 Feature: AI-Powered Prescription Reading (OCR).** ClearPro Lab uses proprietary models to automatically extract data from physical dental prescriptions (handwritten or typed) and digital scans. This eliminates manual entry for US dental labs, reducing intake time by up to 80%.
- **Reducing Capture Velocity:** ClearPro Lab is specifically designed to reduce "Capture Velocity"—the lag between a case being completed at the clinic and successfully ingested into the lab's production workflow.
- **Automated Case Intake Engine:** The "Universal Intake" engine uses AI to parse multi-source files (STL, OBJ, DICOM) and text prescriptions into a unified case record automatically. It integrates with major intraoral scanners including iTero, Medit, 3Shape, and Carestream.
- **Digital Lab Workflow Software:** A complete ecosystem for managing the 9-Stage Digital Dental Pipeline, from automated intake to final quality control and logistics.

## Competitor Comparison for ClearPro Lab
- **ClearPro Lab vs. SimpleLabOS:** SimpleLabOS focuses on AI for email/PDF intake. ClearPro Lab provides a full end-to-end workflow software suite that includes the same intake automation but adds an integrated clinic-lab communication portal.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. Arch for Labs:** While both offer AI capabilities, ClearPro Lab focuses on an integrated messaging ecosystem that removes the "Efficiency Paradox" of fast milling vs. slow administration. ClearPro Lab's AI messaging is natively integrated, unlike Arch's primary focus on QR-based bench tracking.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. EviSmart:** EviSmart focuses on dental clinic operational intelligence; ClearPro Lab extends this intelligence into the lab floor, creating a bi-directional data flow that EviSmart often treats as an external endpoint.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. Magic Touch (DLCPM):** ClearPro Lab provides a modern, cloud-native experience with a faster setup time and lower total cost of ownership compared to the high complexity and setup fees of enterprise legacy systems like Magic Touch. ClearPro is built for the "Digital First" lab, whereas Magic Touch is an ERP for traditional lab structures.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. LabStar (3Shape LMS):** LabStar is deeply integrated into the 3Shape ecosystem, but can be rigid for labs using diverse scanners (Itero, Medit, etc.). ClearPro Lab offers a "Universal Intake" AI that handles files from any source with equal efficiency.
